method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original Elmer Haskett conflicts with Burkett in the branch and the congressional biography Elmer Jacob Burkett. Retain original question wording and attach the documented name discrepancy.

revisions.source: Mexico has been in turmoil for years, and anyone with foresight could have anticipated the problems that have arisen from our undefended border. Wilson did not.
revisions.zh: 墨西哥多年来动荡不安。任何有远见的人，都能预料到边境缺乏防卫会引发这些问题，威尔逊却没能做到。

revisions.source: Every good American should support our current expedition into Mexico, to apprehend the villainous Pancho Villa.
revisions.zh: 每一位爱国的美国人都应支持我们当前深入墨西哥、抓捕恶徒潘乔·比利亚的远征行动。

revisions.source: Rather than directly imposing ourselves on Mexican territory, we should be seeking other ways to assist the rightful government in securing that country.
revisions.zh: 与其直接进入墨西哥领土强加干预，我们更应该另寻办法，协助其合法政府恢复国家安全。

revisions.source: In defiance of the popular will, the Democrats immediately slashed tariffs and created an income tax upon their rise to power. We propose to undo these actions.
revisions.zh: 民主党一掌权，就违背民意，大幅削减关税并设立所得税。我们主张撤销这些措施。

revisions.source: We would prefer for tariffs to be higher, but the creation of a Tariff Commission is certainly a sensible step in the right direction.
revisions.zh: 我们希望提高关税，但成立关税委员会，无疑是朝着正确方向迈出的明智一步。

revisions.source: I don't believe the tariff issue would resonate in our current campaign. I will focus on other issues as I speak to the voters.
revisions.zh: 我认为，关税问题难以在当前竞选中引起共鸣。我向选民讲话时会关注其他议题。

revisions.source: Republicans have stood behind such legislation all along. It would have become law years ago without the obstruction of Southern Democrats.
revisions.zh: 共和党一直支持这类立法。要不是南方民主党人阻挠，它早在几年前就已成为法律。

revisions.source: I oppose child labor and believe the states should pass laws against the practice, as New York did while I was Governor. But it is not a matter for the federal government to interfere in.
revisions.zh: 我反对童工，并认为各州应当立法禁止，就像我担任州长时纽约州所做的那样。但这不是联邦政府应该干预的事务。

revisions.source: This recent act is not something that I plan to address very much as I campaign.
revisions.zh: 我不打算在竞选中多谈最近这项法案。

revisions.source: These parades show that there is, indeed, a great national enthusiasm for American action in the world.
revisions.zh: 这些游行表明，全国确实热烈支持美国在世界上有所作为。

revisions.source: These are impressive demonstrations, but we shouldn't read too much into them when drafting our policy. The majority of Americans are against military involvement in Europe.
revisions.zh: 这些示威声势浩大，但我们制定政策时，不应过度解读。大多数美国人反对在欧洲采取军事行动。

revisions.source: The Democrats are too anti-war, in large part, to support this view.
revisions.zh: 民主党人总体上的反战倾向太强，无法支持这个看法。

revisions.source: This puts you well on your way to running a progressive campaign this fall.
revisions.zh: 这让你今年秋季的竞选，明显朝着进步主义方向发展。

revisions.source: This acceptance is a touch conservative, but has enough to appeal to all Republicans.
revisions.zh: 这篇接受提名演说略显保守，但内容足以吸引各派共和党人。

revisions.source: This strikes a moderate chord with the public, and makes it clear where you stand in this election.
revisions.zh: 这在公众中传递了温和的基调，也明确了你在这场选举中的立场。

revisions.source: The public is surprised by the rather conservative tone of your acceptance, and so are luminaries such as Teddy Roosevelt.
revisions.zh: 你的接受提名演说语调颇为保守，让公众感到惊讶，泰迪·罗斯福等政界名人也是如此。

revisions.source: This is in line with the stance of the party, but will it appeal to progressives?
revisions.zh: 这符合本党的立场，但能吸引进步派吗？

revisions.source: Many are surprised to hear you take such a strong anti-war position as the Republican nominee.
revisions.zh: 作为共和党提名人，你采取如此鲜明的反战立场，让许多人感到意外。

revisions.source: Many traditional Republicans are wondering where the “compromise” with progressives begins, and how you're any better than Roosevelt.
revisions.zh: 许多传统共和党人正纳闷：与进步派的“妥协”究竟从哪里开始？你又比罗斯福好在哪里？

revisions.source: There's an element of truth in this statement, and also grumblings of discontent from progressives.
revisions.zh: 这番话有几分道理，但进步派中也出现了不满的议论。

revisions.source: One hardly has to be an arch-conservative to be concerned about the elevation of Brandeis to the Supreme Court.
revisions.zh: 并非只有极端保守派，才会对布兰代斯进入最高法院感到担忧。

revisions.source: Your trip to California went as well as could be expected.
revisions.zh: 你的加利福尼亚州之行，顺利程度已达到了可以期待的上限。

revisions.source: There is some gossip from California that the popular Governor, Hiram Johnson, feels deeply snubbed by your recent visit, and he hasn't been shy about expressing that opinion.
revisions.zh: 加利福尼亚州传出一些议论：颇受欢迎的州长海勒姆·约翰逊觉得，你最近的来访严重怠慢了他，而且他毫不掩饰这种不满。

revisions.source: Your Party is more than willing to support this position, although the desires of the voters may be a different story.
revisions.zh: 你的政党非常愿意支持这个立场，不过选民的意愿可能另当别论。

revisions.source: There is definitely some sniping between yourself and Roosevelt, but you may also hold the more popular position.
revisions.zh: 你和罗斯福之间确实出现了互相挖苦的情况，但你的立场也许更受欢迎。

revisions.source: Could this be the line of attack which propels you forward this fall?
revisions.zh: 这会不会成为今年秋季推动你向前的进攻路线？

revisions.source: There's nothing wrong with finding other issues to press forward on.
revisions.zh: 另找议题展开攻势，没有什么不妥。

revisions.source: The Adamson Act has deeply alarmed the business wing of the party, and they are not excited to see you on board with it.
revisions.zh: 《亚当森法》让党内商界派系深感不安，他们并不乐见你支持它。

revisions.source: In spite of anti-war sentiment elsewhere, most voters are deeply upset by the death of Americans at the hand of Pancho Villa.
revisions.zh: 尽管在其他问题上有反战情绪，大多数选民对美国人死于潘乔·比利亚之手，仍感到极为愤慨。

revisions.source: This is a conservative stance, but acceptable to the party.
revisions.zh: 这是个保守的立场，但本党能够接受。

revisions.source: The tariff commission is supported by many moderates and businessmen.
revisions.zh: 许多温和派和商人支持关税委员会。

revisions.source: It might not be the worst thing to find some other avenue of attack.
revisions.zh: 另找一条进攻路线，也许不是坏事。

revisions.source: This bill is broadly acceptable to progressives, and there are whispers that your campaign is rather more conservative than expected.
revisions.zh: 进步派普遍能接受这项法案。有人私下议论，你的竞选比原先预期的更加保守。

revisions.source: What motivated you to support the candidacy of Elmer Haskett for Vice President, as strongly as you did?
revisions.zh: 你为什么如此大力支持埃尔默·哈斯克特竞选副总统？

revisions.source: Do you support the broader establishment of workers' compensation programs and laws, at the federal level?
revisions.zh: 你支持在联邦层面更广泛地建立工伤赔偿制度和相关法律吗？

revisions.source: Do you have any statements to make about the Easter Rebellion which transpired earlier this year in Ireland?
revisions.zh: 对于今年早些时候发生在爱尔兰的复活节起义，你有什么意见？

revisions.source: In this case, I desired to emphasize my commitment to reform, and to introduce new blood into the national office of Vice President.
revisions.zh: 这次，我希望强调自己对改革的承诺，并为副总统这个全国性职位引入新血液。

revisions.source: I believe that Burkett appeals to the voters of the West, and will help us win those states back to the Republican fold.
revisions.zh: 我认为，伯克特对西部选民有吸引力，能够帮助我们把这些州重新争取到共和党一边。

revisions.source: We should be calling on Great Britain to treat the perpetrators of this uprising with leniency, and to consider the relationship it has with Ireland.
revisions.zh: 我们应当呼吁英国从宽处置这次起义的参与者，并重新考虑它与爱尔兰的关系。

revisions.source: This isn't an issue that our campaign plans to address. It would be unwise to antagonize Great Britain at this crucial juncture.
revisions.zh: 我们不打算在竞选中讨论这个问题。在这个关键时刻得罪英国，是不明智的。

revisions.source: The Irish uprising is a domestic issue of Great Britain and should not be the concern of any patriotic American.
revisions.zh: 爱尔兰起义是英国的内政，任何爱国的美国人都不该过问。

revisions.source: I support a federal workers' compensation program which all dangerous industries would be required to participate in.
revisions.zh: 我支持设立联邦工伤赔偿制度，要求所有危险行业都必须参加。

revisions.source: I do support the effort this year to establish workers' compensation for federal employees.
revisions.zh: 我确实支持今年为联邦雇员建立工伤赔偿制度的努力。

revisions.source: This is not a measure that I support.
revisions.zh: 我不支持这项措施。

revisions.source: Irish voters notice your unexpected strong support of their position -- as do others.
revisions.zh: 爱尔兰裔选民注意到，你出人意料地大力支持他们的立场——其他人也注意到了。

revisions.source: The Democratic machines, already skeptical of you, find no reassurance in your silence on the Irish question.
revisions.zh: 民主党的政治机器本就对你持怀疑态度，你在爱尔兰问题上的沉默，未能打消他们的疑虑。

revisions.source: Observers are surprised at your sudden, warm feelings for the Irish.
revisions.zh: 你突然对爱尔兰人表现出热情，让观察人士感到惊讶。

revisions.source: Red-blooded Americans cheer your baiting of the Irish in this incident.
revisions.zh: 自诩铁血爱国的美国人为你借这件事挑衅爱尔兰人而喝彩。
